Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner improperly synthesized the evidence by inventing an “earlier-year tie-breaker” for a 405–406/406–407 date range and concluded 405 CE, despite sources indicating the Rhine crossing occurred at the end of 406 (often specified as December 31, 406). This misinterpretation of the date led to the wrong final answer.
